The tariff for the sale of electricity generated at the end-use generating stations of the Petitioner is regulated by the Commission in terms of Section 79(1)(a) of the Electricity ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ _Order in Petition No.808/MP/2025der in Petition No.808/MP/2025_ Page **2** of **10** 6. The Petitioner has also prayed for the grant of an interim tariff, equivalent to 90% of the total tariff claimed for billing purposes, subject to the final determination of the tariff. 7. The matter was admitted on 6.11.2025. During the hearing, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that since the Petitioner has in Prayer (e) of the Petition, sought permission to provisionally bill the Respondents at 90% of the input price of coal, the Commission may direct the Respondents to file their replies on the said interim prayer, at this stage, and list the matter at an early date. After hearing the learned counsel of the Petitioner, notice was issued to the parties to file their replies and rejoinders on the interim prayer of the Petitioner (prayer (e) of the petition). ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ _Order in Petition No.808/MP/2025der in Petition No.808/MP/2025_ Page **3** of **10** 8. None appeared on behalf of the Respondents, despite notice. The Commission, after hearing the learned counsel for the parties, reserved its orders with regard to the prayer of the Petitioner for the grant of an interim tariff in respect of the Kerandari integrated coal mine, in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. However, the Respondents were granted a final opportunity to file their replies with regard to the grant of the interim tariff. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents. 9. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner for the grant of an interim tariff for the input price of coal supplied from the Kerandari Mine. In order to enable the Petitioner to meet its ongoing financial obligations through a reasonable recovery of the cost of mining by the Petitioner to the Respondents and keeping in view that the interim tariff of the integrated coal mine will be subject to adjustment, based on the final tariff to be determined by the Commission, we, on a prudence check, proceed to examine the prayer of the Petitioner for the grant of interim tariff in the instant Petition, as stated in the subsequent paragraphs. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ _Order in Petition No.808/MP/2025der in Petition No.808/MP/2025_ Page **4** of **10** _“Provided that the generating company may request an interim input price in its petition, which may be allowed by the Commission up to 90% of the claimed input price after the first hearing of the application:_ 12. Regulation 10(3) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations provides for the grant of an interim _(3) If the information furnished in the petition is in accordance with these regulations, the Commission may consider granting an interim tariff of up to ninety per cent (90%) of the tariff claimed in the case of a new generating station or unit thereof or transmission system, or element thereof during the first hearing of the application for billing purposes till the final tariff is determined by the Commission:_ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ _Order in Petition No.808/MP/2025der in Petition No.808/MP/2025_ Page **5** of **10** 14. title: Petition under Section 62 and 79 (1) (a) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Chapter-III of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 and Regulation 9 & Chapter-9 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024 for approval of input price of coal supplied from Kerandari Mine for the period from COD i.e. 01.04.2025 to 31.03.2029.
